ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; approximately 96% low-intensity (black) pixels to 4% high-intensity (white) pixels localized to barnacles and scar tissue.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-pigmented contiguous field across both lobes; punctuated by high-contrast white circular pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips and scattered individually across the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 38 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying amplitudes (5-12 pixel depth) present along the entire trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-curved trajectory characterized by a concave arc originating at the median notch and transitioning to a convex curve at the outer lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dense clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity white pixel groups at the extreme left and right tips; additional individual circular spots (~4-8 pixels diameter) scattered across the dark ventral field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, non-aligned light-gray linear pixel streaks visible on the medial-right lobe surface, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustation (barnacle colonization) at both fluke tips, altering the local pixel texture and color; multiple small-scale circular lesions across the dark pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique ring-like circular scar patterns visible on the interior of the right lobe surface.
